newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real up 0.06 pct on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real up 0.06 pct on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.06 percent in calm trade to close at 1.0386 against the dollar due to dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $500 million.
Dealers said they believed the surplus would drop to $300 million when all transactions were registered at the end of the day.
The central bank was expected on Tuesday to simply confirm the real-dollar mini-band between 1.0385 and 1.0435 reais per dollar rather than change the current level, they said.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0441 to the dollar, up 0.01 percent.
On Tuesday, the interbank forex markets will be open only through noon, remain closed Wednesday and reopen Thursday morning.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.44 percent to close at 1.120 per greenback. The real fell 2.47 percent in the month and 12 percent in the year, traders said.
